fields.why: Besides the Rockland-vs-national coverage contrast, the report cites single-group quantities as evidence (≥95% seroconversion, 14%–29% injection-site tenderness, ≥79% seroprevalence), which are summaries; A lists only the comparison.

Rockland County coverage (60%) is set against national coverage (93.4%) introduced 'In comparison', a national estimate treated as fixed, which the brief names explicitly as a fixed referent rather than a pair.
